messages:
Alex (runtime): ran the 30m loadtest on stg with the new kernel handoff + adaptive microbatching. p50 looks fine, but p99 jumps from 220ms to 1.9s when KV cache misses spike. attaching short logs.
Mira (perf): can you paste the exact run cmd and the profiler slice? curious if it's the kernel transition cost or cache refills.
Alex (runtime): run: `./ci/loadtest --profile --kernels=auto,fast_attn --batch=max16 --micro=4 --kv-prefetch=true --duration=1800 --seed=42`
Alex (runtime): profiler snapshot (hot paths):
```
[profiler] sample 172s: kernel-switch 1.6s
  - copy_to_device: 120ms
  - init_kv_cache: 240ms
  - fast_attn_setup: 780ms
  - tok_loop_wait: 460ms
kv-miss-rate ~ 13% in the tail; when miss>10% we see the spike.
```
perf-bot: loadtest summary: 30m, RPS 450, avg latency 240ms, p95 420ms, p99 1.9s, gpu_util 78% (spiky).
Jon (infra): hmm. gpu_util 78% but spikes coincide with kernel handoff windows -> transient headroom consumed by setup. microbatch=4 might be too small to amortize setup cost.
Mira (perf): agree. try micro=8 and max batch=32 for the next run. also disable kv-prefetch to see if prefetch is thrashing memory.
Alex (runtime): scheduled a run: `--micro=8 --batch=max32 --kv-prefetch=false`. will post results in ~40m.
SRE Lead: we need an admission tweak in case that 10%+ kv-miss rate hits. propose: if predicted tail hit probability > 0.05, redirect 10% of requests to warm-only pool (lower latency SLO) and shed non-critical low-priority traffic.
luis-gpu: +1 on warm-only pool. also we could patch kernel selector to prefer the currently-loaded kernel for small batches until warm-complete flag set.
Mira (perf): another idea: track per-GPU kernel residency and add a 200ms cooldown before switching kernels if recent throughput < threshold. reduces churn.
Alex (runtime): noted. action items: (1) next loadtest micro=8/batch32/kv-prefetch=false (2) prototype kernel-residency cooldown (3) add kv-miss based admission rule to canary. I will open PRs.
Jon (infra): add a canary traffic lane for the admission rule. tag @SRE Lead when creating so we can enable fail-open during ramp.
Alex (runtime): opened PR #4112 with draft cooldown + admission hook. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/4112 :thumbsup:
Mira (perf): thanks. if the next run still shows tail spikes we should also instrument per-request kernel-switch markers to correlate with user-level traces.
SRE Lead: copy that. I'll schedule a quick oncall blametest tomorrow to validate shedding behavior under synthetic KV miss bursts.
Alex (runtime): thanks all — will post results and a condensed perf table after the run.
